svg.title: Map Tunisia, open-source SVG maps of Tunisia
svg.desc: The most accurate open-source SVG maps of Tunisia. Six partitions nest with zero gaps or overlaps, built from OpenStreetMap and ISIE electoral data, with names in Arabic, French and English on every shape. Five levels of detail, eight modes; SVG, GeoJSON and TopoJSON. 64 stars, 9 forks, 1,676 views, last 14 days, 140 SVG files.
